title: Voice Defense Rubric
description: For AI voice-session capstones where the student defends a position against a skeptical interlocutor. The model plays the skeptic; the rubric scores the student.

levels.descriptor: Abandons the claim at the first push-back, or repeats it more loudly without new content.
Defends the claim but only by retreating to vaguer versions of it.
Defends the claim by adding evidence and refining what is and is not being asserted.
Defends the claim, narrows it where the skeptic was right to push, and the narrowed version is sharper than the original.
Never concedes, even when the skeptic is plainly correct.
Concedes only when cornered, and grudgingly.
Concedes a specific point and explains what about the claim now changes.
Concedes a specific point, explains what changes, AND identifies what would have caught the error earlier.

criteria.name: Uses the vocabulary of the module correctly

levels.descriptor: Avoids the module's key terms or uses them wrong.
Uses the terms but as labels, not as load-bearing pieces of the argument.
Uses the terms correctly and they are doing real work in the argument.
Uses the terms correctly, defines them in passing for an imagined listener, and connects them to terms from earlier modules.
